title: task_producer_consumer_handoff
summary: Concurrent task production and consumption handoff: an upstream producer generates pending task data, a downstream consumer waits when no tasks are available, computes a checksum result upon receiving a task, with no task loss, no deadlock, and eventual processing of all submitted tasks.

domain_types.name: TaskPayload
domain_types.description: Pure in-memory task data with integer identifier and payload fields, no synchronization or strings

domain_types.name: ChecksumResult
domain_types.description: Pure computed checksum result derived from TaskPayload, integer/boolean fields only

resource_specs.name: task_channel
resource_specs.description: Bounded channel carrying TaskPayload from producer to consumer

resource_specs.name: pending_tasks
resource_specs.description: Modeled count of tasks submitted but not yet processed

resource_specs.name: processed_tasks
resource_specs.description: Modeled count of tasks fully processed by the consumer

clauses.text: The system must never deadlock under concurrent producer and consumer execution.
At all reachable states, pending_tasks stays within 0..=2 (pending_tasks <= 2).
At all reachable states, processed_tasks stays within 0..=2 (processed_tasks <= 2).
Whenever pending_tasks > 0 is reached, on all execution paths pending_tasks eventually returns to 0 (all submitted tasks are eventually processed).
Both producer and consumer workers must be able to complete execution.
Construct TaskPayload entries and compute ChecksumResult from them inside sequential/type holes without synchronization, loops, unsafe, or String formatting.

source_nl: 实现一个任务生产与消费交接功能：上游生成待处理任务数据，下游在无任务时等待并在收到任务后计算校验结果，要求不丢任务、不死锁，所有提交的任务最终都能被处理完。
